questions.question: What is meant by Auditing?
questions.solution_html:
• Auditing is systematic examination of books and records of a business or other organization
  • in order to ascertain or verify and to report upon the fact regarding its financial operation
  • and the result thereof.

questions.question: Mention any two objectives of internal control.
questions.solution_html:
• Operational efficiency and effectiveness, Reliable financial reporting, Compliance with laws
  • and regulations, Safe-guarding of asset.
questions.final_answer: Operational efficiency and effectiveness, Reliable financial reporting, Compliance with laws
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What is meant by intenal control?
questions.solution_html:
• Internal control is the whole system of control, financial or otherwise established by the
  • management in order to carry on the business of the enterprise in an orderly and efficient
  • manner, ensure adherence to management policies, safe-guard the asset and secure as far
  • as possible the completeness and accuracy of the records.
questions.final_answer: as possible the completeness and accuracy of the records

questions.question: Prepare a P&L A/C under departmental accounting from the information given below: Sales: Food -6,00,000 and Beverage -3,00,000 Cost of Sales : Food -1,50,000 and Beverage -1,00,000 Salaries and wages: Food - 1,00,000 and Beverage -50,000 Unallocated expenses : Advertisement -25,000 Gas and electricity -20,000 Rent -50,000 Laundry-10,000 Cleaning materials -5,000 Office expenses -50,000 Note : Unallocated expenses are to be apportioned among departmetns on the following basis: 1. Advertisement -Food -60% and Beverage -40% 2. Gas and electricity : Food -70% and Beverage -30 % 3. All other unallocated expenses are to be apportioned in the ratio of sales.
questions.solution_html: Departmental Income: food- 2,44,333.34 , Beverage – 95,666.66 and Total 3,40,000.
questions.final_answer: Departmental Income: food- 2,44,333.34 , Beverage – 95,666.66 and Total 3,40,000
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Draw the format of an Income Statement under Uniform system of accounts.
questions.solution_html:
• Format of income statement.
  • Particulars Net sales Cost of Payroll Other Income
  • sales and expense Loss
  • related
  • expense
  • Operated Departments
  • Room
  • F & B
  • Telecommunication
  • Other operated departments
  • Rentals and other income
  • Total operated departments: (A)
  • Undistributed operating expense
  • Administrative and general
  • Sales and marketing
  • Property operation and maintenance
  • Utility cost
  • Total undistributed operating expense : (B)
  • Gross operating Profit ( A – B)
  • Less: Fixed charges
  • Income before income tax and profit on gain
  • of property.
  • Add: Profit on sale of property
  • Income before income tax
  • Less: Income tax
  • Net Income
